title: American Heartland Ice Arena
specs: Over 25 years as a premier ice facility in Chicagoland
Guest coaches must be on US Figure Skating’s Coach Compliance list with current USFS membership, NCSI background check, and Safesport
Guest coaches must provide Professional Skaters Association membership card and liability insurance
Skaters must present punch card and sign-in before entering ice
Beginner skaters or Skate School skaters may use freestyle for private lessons depending on age and skating level
Group events and outings can be hosted at the arena
Event space of 17,000 square feet and 4 meeting rooms for up to 100 people
includes: Access to ice for freestyle skating
Certified figure skating or hockey instructors for private lessons
blurb: Guests can participate in freestyle skating sessions, private skating lessons for figure skating and hockey, and host group or private events. The arena offers punch cards for frequent freestyle skaters and certified instructors for lessons. Event spaces and catering options are available for various types of gatherings.
extraNote: Payment for walk-on freestyle must be made in advance via electronic payment only
